grok.rationale: gap_45=1 because the slice states the customer-facing management contract and majority fee stream crossed to DFR/DCM while expressly recording that Robeco's operational processes, systems, and staff did not transfer alongside it at closing. gap_56=0 because T5 processes themselves did not transfer or get re-engineered across the boundary, so there is no process-without-organization mismatch; both T5 and T6 remained with the prior manager. No transitional-services, sub-advisory, operating, or shared-services arrangement was described, so the documented gap was not contractually mitigated.
